parameters.name: ModifyMode
parameters.description:
The method that is used to modify the whitelist. Valid values:

*   **Cover** (default): overwrites the original whitelist.
*   **Append**: appends data to the whitelist.
*   **Delete**: deletes the whitelist.

parameters.name: SecurityIpGroupAttribute
parameters.description: By default, this parameter is left empty. The attribute of the whitelist. The console does not display the whitelist whose value of this parameter is **hidden**.

parameters.name: SecurityIpGroupName
parameters.description:
The name of the IP address whitelist.
><warning>You cannot modify the whitelist that is generated by the system. If you do not specify this parameter, the default whitelist is modified by default.></warning>

parameters.name: SecurityIps
parameters.description: The IP addresses in the whitelist. Up to 1,000 IP addresses can be specified in a whitelist. Separate multiple IP addresses with a comma (,). Specify an IP address in the 0.0.0.0/0, 10.23.12.24, or 10.23.12.24/24 format. In CIDR block 10.23.12.24/24, /24 specifies the length of the prefix of an IP address. The prefix length ranges from 1 to 32.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore modify-security-ips --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --security-ips 100.64.000.0/24,10.101.11.000 --security-ip-group-name default --security-ip-group-attribute hidden --modify-mode Append --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore ModifySecurityIps --region cn-hangzhou --SecurityIpGroupAttribute hidden --SecurityIps '100.64.000.0/24,10.101.11.000' --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --SecurityIpGroupName default --ModifyMode Append
